decision.summary: The screened region (520–664) shows a sustained monotonic descent in U and concurrent rise in E, consistent with gradual subsidence with horizontal extension. No opposing return is observed within the allowed context [485,699]; the motion continues beyond 664 without reversal. The trend lacks a discrete onset/offset edge, one-point spike, or isolated step—thus no temporary offset interval can be confirmed or even tentatively assigned. N remains noisy and uncorrelated. All candidate features are smooth, persistent trends, not temporary offsets.
